name: Cassava
description: Resilient root tuber feeding millions across Nigeria.
description_hausa: Tushen abinci mai gina jiki da juriya a dukkan Najeriya.

diseases.name: Cassava Mosaic Disease (CMD)
diseases.causes: Cassava mosaic geminiviruses transmitted by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci) and through infected stem cuttings.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar cutar virus dake shiga ta kwarin farar kuda da kuma sandar rogo da aka shuka mai cuta.
diseases.symptoms: Distorted mottled leaves with distinct green-yellow patches, twisted leaflets, stunted plant and poor tuber growth.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye mai tabon kore da rawaya yana lankwashewa, shuka bata girma sosai kuma tana rage yawan rogo.
diseases.treatment: No chemical cure once infected. Uproot and burn diseased plants; only select healthy mother plants for cuttings.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin feshi. Tumɓuke shukar da ta kamu a ƙone ta; kada a shuka sandar da ta fito daga mai ciwo.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant varieties (e.g., TME 419, TMS 30572) and control whitefly populations using neem extracts.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka nau'ukan rogo masu juriya (TME 419 ko TMS 30572) kuma a fesa ruwan dogon yaro don korar farar kuda.

diseases.name: Cassava Bacterial Blight (CBB)
diseases.causes: Bacterium (Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. manihotis) spread by rain splash, contaminated tools, and infected cuttings.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar bakteriya mai yaduwa ta hanyar yayyafin ruwan sama, kayan aiki, da sandar shuka mai ciwo.
diseases.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown, gum exudate on stems, wilting and dieback of young shoot tips.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ɗigo-ɗigo masu ruwa a jikin ganye dake komawa ruwan kasa, maniyyi mai kauri a kara, da bushewar kololuwar rogo.
diseases.treatment: Prune infected branches at the first sign and burn them. Disinfect machetes and cutting tools with bleach or alcohol.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Datse rassan da suka kamu da wuri a ƙone su. Wanke adduna da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta.
diseases.prevention: Plant disease-free certified stems at the start of rains and practice crop rotation with legumes or maize.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi amfani da ingantattun sandunan shuka marasa cuta, sannan a canza shuka da wake ko masara.

diseases.name: Cassava Brown Streak Disease (CBSD)
diseases.causes: Cassava brown streak viruses vectored by whiteflies, often silently destroying tuber roots underground.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar cutar virus da farar kuda ke yadawa, tana lalata rogo a karkashin kasa ba tare da an sani ba.
diseases.symptoms: Feathery chlorosis along secondary leaf veins, brown streaks on young stems, dry brown necrotic rot inside roots.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Farin layi a jikin jijiyoyin ganye, baƙaƙen zane a kara, da bushewar ruɓa a cikin tubalin rogon da ke ƙasa.
diseases.treatment: Harvest tubers early before rot spreads throughout root flesh; cull and discard infected planting stakes.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Kwashe girbin rogo da wuri kafin ruɓar ta cinye cikin rogon; zubar da sandunan da suka kamu.
diseases.prevention: Source clean indexed cuttings from research institutes (IITA/NRCRI) and strictly quarantine new planting materials.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Sami sandunan rogo daga cibiyar bincike ta IITA ko NRCRI masu inganci marasa cuta.

diseases.name: Cassava Anthracnose
diseases.causes: Fungus (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides f. sp. manihotis) entering through wounds created by sucking insects.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake shiga ta raunin da kwarin tsotse ruwan kara suka haifar.
diseases.symptoms: Deep oval cankers on green stems, leaf wilting, petiole defoliation, brittle stems snapping easily in wind.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Zuzzurfan raunuka a jikin jikin koriyar kara, zubewar ganye, da karyewar karan rogo cikin sauki lokacin iska.
diseases.treatment: Spray copper-based fungicides if severe during wet season; cut down badly damaged stems.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin naman gwari mai tagulla (copper) idan cutar ta tsananta a damina; datse kararen da suka lalace.
diseases.prevention: Control pseudotheraptus bugs, select smooth healthy planting stakes, and burn post-harvest crop debris.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kare gona daga kwarin cizo, zabi sanda mai lafiya mara rauni, kuma a share gona bayan girbi.

diseases.name: Cassava Green Mite Damage
diseases.causes: Microscopic green mites (Mononychellus tanajoa) feeding on sap from young leaves during dry spells.
diseases.causes_hausa: Ƙananan kwarin gizo-gizo masu kore da ke tsotse ruwan ƙananan ganyen rogo a lokacin fari da rani.
diseases.symptoms: Tiny yellow speckles and mottled pinpricks on terminal leaves, "candle-stick" defoliation where top leaves drop completely.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Digo-digo masu rawaya a saman ganyen rogo, da zubar ganye har karan ya zama kamar sandar kyandir.
diseases.treatment: Spray with botanical neem oil, sulfur powder solution, or introduce natural predatory typhlodromalus mites.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa man dogon yaro ko ruwan garin sulfur, ko amfani da kwarin halitta masu cin kwarin kore.
diseases.prevention: Early planting with onset of rains so cassava establishes before dry season mite explosion.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka da wuri da zaran damina ta sauka domin rogo ya yi kauri kafin lokacin rani da kwari.

diseases.name: Healthy Cassava
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — rogo yana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau.
diseases.symptoms: Broad, deeply-lobed vibrant green leaves, smooth sturdy stems, no spots or mosaic mottling.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Faffadan ganye kore mai lafiya, kara mai karfi da kauri ba tare da wani tabo ko lankwashewa ba.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain regular weeding and adequate soil fertility.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Ci gaba da noma ciyawa da kula da lafiyar kasa.
diseases.prevention: Continue field sanitation, inspect weekly for whiteflies, and keep ridge soil weed-free.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Ci gaba da duba gona akai-akai, kiyaye tsaftar gona, da kare ta daga kwari.

name: Maize
description: Primary grain crop across Northern and Middle Belt Nigeria.
description_hausa: Babban hatsi a Arewacin Najeriya da tsakiyar ƙasar.

diseases.name: Maize Streak Virus (MSV)
diseases.causes: Maize streak geminivirus transmitted rapidly by leafhoppers (Cicadulina species).
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar virus da kwarin falkon ganye (leafhoppers) ke yadawa cikin sauri.
diseases.symptoms: Narrow continuous or broken pale yellow streaks parallel to leaf veins, plant stunting, small barren cobs.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Siraran layuka masu rawaya a jikin jijiyoyin ganye, masarar na zama gajera kuma bata fitar da cikakkiyar zangarniya.
diseases.treatment: Infected plants cannot be cured. Rogue out young diseased plants to reduce reservoir for leafhoppers.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Ba a warkar da ita da maganin feshi. Tumɓuke shukar da ta kamu a farko don hana kwarin yada cutar.
diseases.prevention: Plant certified streak-resistant varieties (such as SAMMAZ series) and treat seeds with imidacloprid dressing.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka nau'ukan SAMMAZ masu jure cutar streak, kuma a yi wa irin masara magani kafin shukawa.

diseases.name: Maize Rust
diseases.causes: Fungus (Puccinia sorghi) carried by airborne spores during humid, cooler periods.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari (Puccinia sorghi) da iska ke ɗauka a lokacin sanyi da laima.
diseases.symptoms: Small, powdery cinnamon-brown to golden-brown pustules scattered across both leaf surfaces.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ƙuraje masu launin kasa-kasa ko tsatsa da ke fitar da gari a gaban da bayan ganyen masara.
diseases.treatment: Apply triazole or strobilurin fungicides (e.g., azoxystrobin/mancozeb) if severe before tasseling.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin mancozeb ko triazole idan tsatsar ta bayyana kafin masara ta fitar da zangarniya.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids early in the season to escape peak spore dispersal windows.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka da wuri don masara ta yi kwari kafin lokacin tsatsa, kuma a shuka iri mai juriya.

diseases.name: Fall Armyworm (FAW)
diseases.causes: Voracious larvae of Spodoptera frugiperda feeding deep inside the plant whorl.
diseases.causes_hausa: Tsutsa mai muguwar cin abinci (Spodoptera frugiperda) dake buya a cikin kogon ganyen masara.
diseases.symptoms: Windowed ragged leaf holes, sawdust-like frass in the central funnel, chewed growing points.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Cin ganye kamar an yayyaga shi, kashin tsutsa kamar garin itace a kogon masara, da cin zaren masara.
diseases.treatment: Pour neem seed slurry or small pinch of fine wood ash into the whorl; spray emamectin benzoate or spinetoram in late evening.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Sanya tokar itace ko ruwan kwayar dogon yaro a kogon masara; ko fesa maganin emamectin da maraice.
diseases.prevention: Intercrop with cowpea or desmodium, scout whorls twice a week from 10 days after germination.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi shukar lafce da wake, kuma a rika binciken kogon masara sau biyu a mako daga fitowarta.

diseases.name: Northern Corn Leaf Blight (NCLB)
diseases.causes: Fungus (Exserohilum turcicum) favored by moderate temperatures and persistent dew or moisture.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai son laima da raɓa da ke wanzuwa a ragowar masarar kaka.
diseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical, cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions that coalesce and scorch entire leaves.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Dogayen tabo masu siffar sigari mai launin toka-kore da ke haduwa su kona daukacin ganyen.
diseases.treatment: Apply foliar fungicide (Mancozeb or carbendazim) at first sight on lower leaves.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin Mancozeb ko carbendazim da zaran an ga raunuka a kasan ganye.
diseases.prevention: Rotate fields with non-grass crops (soybeans, groundnut, cowpea) and bury crop residues.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Canza shuka da wake ko waken soya, kuma a kakkabe ragowar shuka bayan girbi.

diseases.name: Maize Common Smut
diseases.causes: Fungus (Ustilago maydis) infecting through wounds from insects, hail, or weeding hoes.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake shiga ta raunin fartanya, kwari, ko ruwan kankara.
diseases.symptoms: Large silvery-white fleshy galls that swell, burst open, and release masses of black powdery spores.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kumburi mai kauri fari-fari a jikin masara ko kan zangarniya dake fashewa yana fitar da baƙin gari.
diseases.treatment: Cut off galls carefully before they rupture and bury or burn them away from the field.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Yanke kumburin a hankali kafin ya fashe a binne shi ko a kona shi nesa da gona.
diseases.prevention: Avoid mechanical damage during weeding, balanced nitrogen/phosphorus fertilizer, resistant varieties.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kiyaye sare masara da fartanya yayin huda, sa daidaitaccen taki, da shuka iri mai juriya.

diseases.name: Healthy Maize
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy dark green leaves.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — masara tana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu duhun kore.
diseases.symptoms: Thick upright stalk, deep green unblemished leaves, clean whorl, well-filled cobs with golden silk.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Karan masara mai kauri da tsayi, ganye kore mai kyau ba tare da tabo ko cizon tsutsa ba.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue timely urea top-dressing and regular weeding.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Ci gaba da zuba takin urea a lokacin da ya dace da cire ciyawa.
diseases.prevention: Maintain balanced fertilizer application, monitor for armyworm, and control weeds.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Ci gaba da kula da taki, duba gona don kariya daga tsutsar soja, da kiyaye laima.

name: Tomato
description: Valued vegetable grown across Fadama irrigation plains in Kano, Kaduna, and Plateau.
description_hausa: Kayan lambu mai muhimmanci a fadama a Kano, Kaduna, da Filato.

diseases.name: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV)
diseases.causes: Begomovirus vectored by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci).
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar virus da farar kuda ke yadawa tsakanin gonakin tumatir.
diseases.symptoms: Upward curling and cupping of leaflet margins, yellowing between veins, stunted bushy growth, flower abortion.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Lankwashewar ganye sama kamar kofi, koren ganye na komawa rawaya, da zubar fure ba tare da tumatir ya kankama ba.
diseases.treatment: Rogue out severely stunted plants. Spray neem oil solution or insecticidal soap to reduce whitefly vector numbers.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Tumɓuke shukar da ta nakasa; fesa man dogon yaro ko sabulun magani don kashe farar kuda.
diseases.prevention: Use 40-mesh insect netting over nursery beds, plant barrier crops (maize/sorghum) around plots.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Rufe gandun shuka da raga mai kariya daga kwari, kuma a shuka masara a gefen lambu.

diseases.name: Tomato Late Blight
diseases.causes: Oomycete pathogen (Phytophthora infestans) triggered by cool, wet, humid weather conditions.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar cuta mai son sanyi, ruwa da laima da ke barna a lokacin damina ko sanyin hunturu.
diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked dark greasy spots that enlarge rapidly, white fungal fuzz on undersides, brown rotting fruit.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Tabo mai duhu kamar an zuba ruwan zafi a ganye, farin gari a kasan ganye, da rubewar tumatir yana komawa baki.
diseases.treatment: Spray with metalaxyl + mancozeb or copper oxychloride immediately upon detection.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin metalaxyl tare da mancozeb ko maganin tagulla (copper) ba tare da bata lokaci ba.
diseases.prevention: Stake plants off wet soil, ensure wide spacing for air circulation, avoid overhead sprinkler watering.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Dora tumatir a kan sanduna, bada fili tsakanin shuka, kuma a guji yayyafa ruwa ta sama.

diseases.name: Tomato Fusarium Wilt
diseases.causes: Soil-borne fungus (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici) clogging the plant water vessels.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake zama a cikin kasa yana toshe hanyoyin ruwan da ke cikin karan tumatir.
diseases.symptoms: Yellowing of lower leaves often on one side of plant first, daytime wilting, brown ring inside cut stem base.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye na komawa rawaya a bangare daya na shuka, kwanciyar ganye da rana, da launin ruwan kasa a cikin karan tumatir.
diseases.treatment: No chemical cure. Remove and burn infected plants to prevent soil buildup; solarize seedbeds.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin da ke warkar da shi da zarar ya shiga kara. Tumɓuke shukar a ƙone ta, a bar rana ta gasa kasar.
diseases.prevention: Use resistant hybrid cultivars (marked VF or VFN), raise soil pH to 6.5–7.0 with lime/wood ash, 4-year crop rotation.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka irin tumatir mai juriya (VFN), sanya toka a kasa don rage tsami, kuma a canza shuka na shekaru hudu.

diseases.name: Bacterial Spot
diseases.causes: Bacterium (Xanthomonas vesicatoria) spread by splashing water and handling wet plants.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar bakteriya mai yaduwa ta hanyar ruwan sama, yayyafi, da taba shuka a lokacin da take da jika.
diseases.symptoms: Small, circular, greasy dark brown lesions surrounded by a yellow halo, scabby spots on green fruit.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kananan tabo masu duhun ruwan kasa da kewayen rawaya, da kuraje a jikin danyen tumatir.
diseases.treatment: Apply copper hydroxide bactericide mixed with mancozeb at weekly intervals during rainy periods.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin tagulla (copper) tare da mancozeb kowanne mako a lokacin damina.
diseases.prevention: Disinfect seeds with hot water (50°C for 25 min) before sowing; avoid working in the field when plants are wet.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Wanke iri a ruwan dumi kafin shuka, kuma a guji shiga gonar tumatir lokacin da ganyen ke da jika.

diseases.name: Early Blight
diseases.causes: Fungus (Alternaria solani) thriving in alternating wet and dry conditions.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai son jika da bushewa dake zama a ragowar shuka.
diseases.symptoms: Target-like concentric dark brown rings with yellow halo on older lower leaves, collar rot on young stems.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Digo-digo masu da'ira kamar manufa masu launin kasa mai duhu tare da kewayen rawaya a kasan ganye.
diseases.treatment: Prune infected lower leaves, stake plants to keep leaves off damp soil, spray copper or chlorothalonil.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Datse ƙananan ganyen da suka kamu, ɗaure shukar a jikin sanda, fesa maganin tagulla ko chlorothalonil.
diseases.prevention: Mulching with clean dry straw, furrow or drip irrigation, rotate with maize, beans, or sorghum.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Sanya ciyawa mai tsabta a ƙasa, ban ruwa a tushe ba ta sama ba, kuma a canza shuka da hatsi.

diseases.name: Healthy Tomato
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy dark green leaves.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — tumatir yana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau.
diseases.symptoms: Vibrant green upright foliage, strong hairy stems, profuse yellow flowers, glossy unblemished fruit.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye kore mai kauri ba tare da wani tabo ko lanƙwasa ba, fure mai kyau, da tumatir mai santsi da lafiya.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain consistent watering at base and balanced calcium/potassium nutrition.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Ci gaba da ba da ruwa a tushe akai-akai da kuma sanya toka don samun sinadarin potassium.
diseases.prevention: Stake plants, remove sucker leaves near ground, and monitor for early pest emergence.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Dora tumatir a sanda, cire kananan rassa na kusa da kasa, kuma a duba gona akai-akai.

name: Onion
description: Vital cash crop grown in dry season under irrigation in Kano, Sokoto, and Kebbi.
description_hausa: Muhimmin amfanin gona da ake nomawa a lokacin rani ta hanyar ban ruwa a Kano, Sokoto, da Kebbi.

diseases.name: Purple Blotch
diseases.causes: Fungus (Alternaria porri) favored by warm, humid rainy or dew conditions and dense planting.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari (Alternaria porri) mai yaduwa a lokacin dumi da laima ko raɓa mai yawa da dashe a matse.
diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions that turn purple to dark brown with yellow rings around borders, leaves collapse at center.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Raunuka masu ruwan hoda da duhu tare da kewayen launin rawaya, ganyen albasa na karkacewa yana karyewa.
diseases.treatment: Apply recommended copper fungicide, Mancozeb or difenoconazole. Spray neem oil solution every 7 days.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin naman gwari mai tagulla ko Mancozeb. Ko fesa ruwan maganin dogon-yaro kowanne kwanaki 7.
diseases.prevention: Wide spacing for good airflow, 3-year crop rotation without garlic or shallots, avoid overhead splashing.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Bada fili tsakanin shuka don samun iska, canza shuka na shekaru 3 ba tare da tafarnuwa ba, guji watsa ruwa ta sama.

diseases.name: Fusarium Rot
diseases.causes: Soil-borne fungus (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cepae) persisting in soil for decades.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar naman gwari a cikin ƙasa (Fusarium oxysporum) da ke dadewa a gona.
diseases.symptoms: Yellowing and curling of leaf tips, roots rot away turning pinkish-brown, base of bulb softens with white mold.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganyen yana yin rawaya yana lankwashewa, saiwar tana rube tana canza launi zuwa ja/kasa, tushen albasar na ruɓewa.
diseases.treatment: No chemical cure once bulb rots. Uproot and burn infected bulbs; solarize nursery beds with clear polythene.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin da ke warkar da ruɓewar tushe. Cire wadanda suka kamu a ƙone su; gasa gandun shuka da rana.
diseases.prevention: Use certified clean seedlings, rotate with maize or sorghum, avoid planting in flooded poorly drained soil.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi amfani da ingantaccen iri, canza shuka da masara ko dawa, kaucewa ruwa mai tsayawa a gona.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.causes: Fungus-like organism (Peronospora destructor) thriving during cool, humid nights and morning dews.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar cuta mai son sanyin dare, raɓa mai yawa da laimar safe.
diseases.symptoms: Pale oval patches with purplish-gray velvety fuzz on leaf surfaces; leaf tips shrivel, turn pale and collapse.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Tabo mai haske da gari mai launin ruwan hoda-toka a saman ganye; bakin ganyen na bushewa yana kwanciya.
diseases.treatment: Spray systemic metalaxyl + mancozeb or cymoxanil early before full outbreak takes over foliage.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin metalaxyl ko mancozeb da safe da zaran an ga alamar fari a ganyen.
diseases.prevention: Orient planting beds in direction of prevailing wind for quick drying of morning dew; rotate with grain crops.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Fara shuka ta hanyar da iska za ta rika busar da raɓar safe da sauri; canza gona da hatsi.

diseases.name: Onion Thrips
diseases.causes: Tiny slender insects (Thrips tabaci) rasping leaf tissues and sucking plant juices during hot dry weather.
diseases.causes_hausa: Ƙananan kwarin thrips masu shiga kogon ganyen albasa suna tsotse ruwan ganye a lokacin zafi da rani.
diseases.symptoms: Silvery-white patches and streaks on leaves, tiny black fecal dots, twisted curling leaves that dry up prematurely.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Farin zane mai haske kamar azurfa a jikin ganye, ƙananan ɗigo baƙaƙe na kashi, da lankwashewar ganye yana bushewa.
diseases.treatment: Spray neem seed kernel extract (5%), spinosad or lambda-cyhalothrin into the base of the leaf sheaths in early morning.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa ruwan maganin dogon yaro ko spinosad da sassafe a tsakiyar kogon ganyen albasa.
diseases.prevention: Maintain adequate furrow irrigation (avoid water stress), use blue sticky traps, clear grassy weed borders.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kiyaye ba da ruwa akai-akai don hana bushewa, sanya tarkon kwarin, da cire ciyawar bakin gona.

diseases.name: Neck Rot
diseases.causes: Fungus (Botrytis allii) entering through unhealed thick necks at harvest and thriving in poorly cured damp barns.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake shiga ta wuyan albasar da bai bushe ba yayin girbi, yana barna a rumbu marar iska.
diseases.symptoms: Soft sunken brown rot around the neck of the bulb, gray mold and black sclerotia bodies inside bulb scales during storage.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ruɓewa mai laushi a wuyan albasar da ke shiga ciki, farin gari da ƙwayoyin cuta baƙaƙe a cikin rumbun ajiya.
diseases.treatment: Sort out and discard soft neck bulbs immediately; dry remaining stock in shade with cross-ventilation.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Ware duk albasar da wuyanta ya yi laushi a cire ta; a busar da sauran a inuwa mai isasshen iska.
diseases.prevention: Withhold irrigation 10-14 days before harvest; harvest only when 70% of necks have naturally fallen; cure 2 weeks.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Tsayar da ban ruwa kwanaki 10-14 kafin girbi; girbe lokacin da kashi 70% na wuyan ya kwanta da kansa; shanya makonni 2.

diseases.name: Healthy Onion
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous tubular green leaves and firm healthy bulbs.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — albasa tana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu karfi da kwan albasa mai tauri.
diseases.symptoms: Upright cylindrical tubular leaves, bright waxy coating, tight firm neck, shiny intact outer bulb skin.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Dogayen ganye masu siffar bututu kore mai haske, wuya mai tauri, da kwan albasa mai kyau ba tare da tabo ba.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep irrigation schedule regular until bulbs approach final maturity.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Ci gaba da ba da ruwa daidai har lokacin da kwan albasar ya cika sosai.
diseases.prevention: Maintain balanced fertilizer, scout for thrips weekly, and stop watering on time before harvest.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kula da taki, bincika gona don kariya daga thrips, kuma a tsayar da ruwa a lokacin da ya dace kafin girbi.

name: Pepper (Chili / Atarodo)
description: High-value condiment cultivated in home gardens and commercial plots.
description_hausa: Kayan lambu mai riba da ake buƙata a kowanne gida.

diseases.name: Pepper Mosaic Virus
diseases.causes: Potyviruses transmitted non-persistently by aphids and mechanically by handling.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar virus da kwarin aphid ke yadawa ko ta hanyar taba shuka mai cuta zuwa mara cuta.
diseases.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green patterns on leaves, leaf distortion, blister-like puckering, bumpy stunted peppers.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Zane mai launin kore-haske da duhu a ganye, lankwashewar ganye, da barkono mai kuraje marar girma.
diseases.treatment: No chemical cure. Remove and destroy infected plants; sanitize hands and pruning knives with soapy water.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin feshi. Tumɓuke shukar da ta kamu a ƙone ta; wanke hannaye da wukake da sabulu.
diseases.prevention: Spray reflective silver mulch to repel aphids; use clean certified seeds and manage surrounding broadleaf weeds.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi amfani da kariya don korar aphid, shuka ingantaccen iri mara cuta, da cire ciyawar daji.

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
diseases.causes: Soil bacterium (Ralstonia solanacearum) entering root injuries in warm, waterlogged soils.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar bakteriya dake shiga ta raunin saiwa a lokacin dumi da ruwa mai tsayawa a gona.
diseases.symptoms: Rapid green wilting without initial leaf yellowing; stems cut and placed in water ooze milky bacterial streams.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kwanciyar ganye da bushewa a lokaci guda yayin da ganyen ke da koren launi; yanke kara a sa a ruwa yana fitar da farin madara.
diseases.treatment: Immediately dig up and discard wilted plants with surrounding soil; do not flood-irrigate across infected beds.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Tumɓuke shukar da kasan da ke jikinta a zubar; kada a bar ruwa ya ratsa ta wurin zuwa sauran gona.
diseases.prevention: Plant on high raised ridges to prevent waterlogging; rotate with non-host crops like maize or sorghum for 3 years.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka a kan dogayen kunyoyi don gudun ruwa mai tsayawa; canza shuka da masara ko dawa na shekaru 3.

diseases.name: Anthracnose
diseases.causes: Fungus (Colletotrichum capsici) spread by splashing rain on ripening peppers.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai yaduwa ta hanyar yayyafin ruwan sama a lokacin da barkono ke nuna.
diseases.symptoms: Sunken, circular water-soaked dark spots on pods, concentric rings of salmon-pink to black spores, premature fruit drop.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Zuzzurfan raunuka masu duhu a jikin barkono, kewayen ɗigo ja-ruwan-hoda ko baki, da zubar danyen ko nannun barkono.
diseases.treatment: Spray protective copper oxychloride, mancozeb or azoxystrobin as soon as first flowers begin to fruit.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin tagulla (copper) ko mancozeb da zaran fure ya fara kankama barkono.
diseases.prevention: Use disease-free seeds treated with hot water; space plants widely for rapid drying; harvest ripe fruit promptly.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Wanke iri da ruwan dumi kafin shuka; bada tazara tsakanin shuka; kuma a kwashe nunan barkono da wuri.

diseases.name: Pepper Leaf Spot
diseases.causes: Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria spread by raindrops, mist, and overhead irrigation.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar bakteriya mai yaduwa ta yayyafin ruwan sama da shayarwa ta sama.
diseases.symptoms: Small, circular dark spots with water-soaked halos; spots coalesce causing severe defoliation and exposed sunscalded fruit.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ƙananan ɗigo masu duhu dake sa ganye zubewa gaba ɗaya, har rana ta kona barkonon da babu inuwar ganye.
diseases.treatment: Spray copper-based bactericide at early symptom onset; remove fallen leaves and burn them.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin tagulla da wuri; share ganyen da suka zube a ƙone su.
diseases.prevention: Avoid sprinkler irrigation; rotate with non-solanaceous crops (avoid planting after tomato or eggplant).
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kada a watsa ruwa ta sama; canza shuka da amfanin gonar da ba barkono ko tumatir ba.

diseases.name: Healthy Pepper
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous branching and shiny green leaves.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — barkono yana cikin koshin lafiya da rassa masu kyau da ganye kore.
diseases.symptoms: Dark green smooth foliage, strong central stem with sturdy branches, abundant white flowers and glossy crisp peppers.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye kore mai santsi ba tare da tabo ko lanƙwasa ba, rassa masu karfi, da barkono mai santsi da lafiya.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep soil evenly moist and apply compost or balanced NPK fertilizer.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Kula da laima a kasa da zuba takin gargajiya ko NPK daidai.
diseases.prevention: Mulch around stems, inspect for mites and aphids weekly, and harvest ripe peppers on time.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Sanya ciyawa a kasan shuka don rike laima, duba kwari akai-akai, kuma a tsinke barkono a kan kari.

name: Cowpea (Beans)
description: Vital protein legume for human food and fodder across Nigeria.
description_hausa: Abincin gina jiki mai muhimmanci ga mutane da dabbobi.

diseases.name: Cowpea Mosaic Virus (CPMV)
diseases.causes: Comovirus transmitted by leaf beetles (Ootheca mutabilis) and through infected seeds.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar virus da kwarin ganye masu fuka-fuki (beetles) da kuma irin da ke dauke da cutar ke yadawa.
diseases.symptoms: Strong green-and-yellow mosaic mottling, blistered puckered leaf surface, deformed narrow pods with fewer seeds.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Zane mai launin rawaya da kore a ganye, kunkumar ganye, da kwasfa marar cika da bata fitar da cikakken wake ba.
diseases.treatment: Infected plants cannot be cured. Rogue out early infected plants; control leaf beetle vectors with bio-pesticides.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Ba a warkar da ita. Tumɓuke shukar da ta kamu da wuri; fesa maganin kashe kwarin da ke cin ganye.
diseases.prevention: Plant certified virus-free seeds from IITA/NIHORT; plant early in the season to escape peak beetle population.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka ingantaccen irin IITA wanda ba shi da cuta, kuma a shuka da wuri don gujewa lokacin yaduwar kwari.

diseases.name: Bacterial Blight
diseases.causes: Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. vignicola transmitted via infected seeds and rain splashes.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar bakteriya da ke shiga ta jikin iri da kuma yayyafin ruwan sama.
diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked spots turning reddish-brown with broad yellow margins, stem cracking, pod cankers with aborted seeds.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ɗigo-ɗigo masu ruwa-ruwa dake zama ja/kasa tare da gefe mai rawaya, fashewar kara, da raunuka a kwasfa.
diseases.treatment: Remove infected plants early. Avoid working in the farm while leaves are wet to prevent bacterial spread.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Cire masu ciwo da wuri. Kada ka yi aiki a gona yayin da ganyen ke da jika don hana yaduwa.
diseases.prevention: Use certified IITA disease-free seeds; practice crop rotation with maize or sorghum; destroy dry crop residues.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi amfani da ingantaccen irin IITA; canza shuka da masara ko dawa; kuma a kakkabe ragowar shuka.

diseases.name: Cowpea Anthracnose
diseases.causes: Fungus (Colletotrichum destructivum) favored by high humidity, warm rains, and dense planting.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai son laima, ruwan sama mai dumi, da dashe mai yawan cushewa.
diseases.symptoms: Lens-shaped, sunken reddish-brown to black lesions on stems and petioles; brown spots on pods that pinch seed growth.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Zuzzurfan raunuka masu launin ja-kasa ko baki a kara da jikin kwasfa, yana sa waken shanyewa a cikin kwasfa.
diseases.treatment: Spray with systemic carbendazim or mancozeb as soon as lesions appear on stems before flowering.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin mancozeb ko carbendazim da zaran an ga raunuka a jikin kara kafin fure.
diseases.prevention: Seed treatment with thiram or captan; intercrop cowpea with cereal crops (sorghum/millet) to reduce splash dispersal.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Wanke iri da maganin thiram kafin shuka; yi lafce da dawa ko gero don rage yayyafin ruwa.

diseases.name: Cowpea Weevil (Storage Bruchid)
diseases.causes: Callosobruchus maculatus beetles laying tiny eggs on field pods and multiplying exponentially in storage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwarin wake (kunkuru) dake yin kwai a jikin kwasfa a gona kuma yana kyanKyasa yana cin hatsi a rumbu.
diseases.symptoms: Tiny white eggs glued on pod surface, round exit holes in beans, powdery flour dust inside storage bags.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Farin ƙwai a jikin kwasfa a gona, ramuka zagaye a jikin kwayar wake, da garin wake a cikin buhu.
diseases.treatment: Store harvested dry beans in triple-layer hermetic PICS bags (Purdue Improved Crop Storage) without chemicals.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Zuba busashen wake a cikin buhunan PICS masu kariya (rufe bakin ba tare da iska ba) ba tare da maganin guba ba.
diseases.prevention: Harvest mature dry pods promptly; sun-dry grain thoroughly on clean tarpaulins before sealing in airtight storage.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kwashe busassun kwasfa da wuri; shanya waken a rana a kan leda mai kyau kafin rufewa a buhunan PICS.

diseases.name: Healthy Cowpea
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — wake yana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau.
diseases.symptoms: Broad trifoliate green leaves, vigorous runners or upright bushy canopy, abundant purple/white flowers, long straight pods.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye kore mai fadi mai ganye uku-uku, fure mai kyau, da dogayen kwasfofi masu cika ba tare da ramuka ba.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Scout for pod borers at early flowering stage.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Kula da binciken kwari a lokacin da wake ya fara fure.
diseases.prevention: Keep field free of weed hosts, monitor for flower thrips, and harvest pods as they dry.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Cire ciyawa a bakin gona, kula da kwarin fure, kuma a kwashe kwasfa da zaran ta bushe.

name: Groundnut (Peanut)
description: High-value oilseed and staple legume grown across the savanna.
description_hausa: Shukar mai da abinci mai daraja a yankin savanna.

diseases.name: Groundnut Rosette Virus
diseases.causes: Complex of viruses (GRAV, GRV, and satellite RNA) spread by groundnut aphids (Aphis craccivora).
diseases.causes_hausa: Cutar virus da kwarin gyada (aphid) ke yadawa a lokacin da aka yi jinkirin shuka.
diseases.symptoms: Extreme stunting, bunched leaves forming compact rosette cushions, bright yellow chlorosis, failure to produce pods.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Shuka na zama ƙanƙanuwa ganye na taruwa a wuri guda yana yin rawaya, kuma gyadar bata kafa kwaya a kasa ba.
diseases.treatment: Uproot early infected plants to halt aphid feeding chain; spray neem seed oil to control aphid vector colonies.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Tumɓuke masu cuta da wuri; fesa man dogon yaro don kashe kwarin aphid.
diseases.prevention: Plant at close spacing (75 cm x 10 cm) early in the season to form dense canopy that repels aphids; plant SAMNUT varieties.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka da wuri kuma a matse domin inuwar ganyen na korar kwari; shuka irin SAMNUT mai juriya.

diseases.name: Early Leaf Spot
diseases.hausa_name: Tabon Ganye na Farko (Early Leaf Spot)
diseases.causes: Fungus (Passalora arachidicola) appearing 3–5 weeks after planting during humid conditions.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake fitowa makonni 3 zuwa 5 bayan shuka a lokacin laima.
diseases.symptoms: Circular reddish-brown to dark brown spots with a prominent yellow halo on upper leaf surfaces.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Digo zagaye mai launin ja-kasa da duhu tare da kewayen rawaya mai haske a saman ganyen gyada.
diseases.treatment: Spray with chlorothalonil or carbendazim + mancozeb as soon as spots appear on lower canopy.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin mancozeb ko chlorothalonil da zaran an ga digo a kasan ganye.
diseases.prevention: Rotate with cereals (millet/sorghum/maize), bury crop residues with deep plowing, avoid continuous groundnut cropping.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Canza shuka da gero, dawa ko masara, a kakkabe ragowar shuka, kuma kada a maimaita gyada a gona daya.

diseases.name: Late Leaf Spot
diseases.hausa_name: Tabon Ganye na Baya (Late Leaf Spot)
diseases.causes: Fungus (Nothopassalora personata) attacking later in the season (6–8 weeks) causing severe defoliation.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake bayyana a karshen kakar gyada yana sa dukkan ganye zubewa kafin girbi.
diseases.symptoms: Nearly black, circular spots on lower leaf surface without yellow halos, rough velvety spore cushions underneath, severe leaf drop.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Digo baki-kirin a kasan ganye ba tare da kewayen rawaya ba, yana sa dukkan ganyen gyadar zubewa.
diseases.treatment: Apply systemic fungicide (hexaconazole or tebuconazole) when lower leaves begin dropping.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin tebuconazole ko hexaconazole lokacin da ganye ya fara zubewa.
diseases.prevention: Plant tolerant cultivars, intercrop with cereals, and harvest on time before pod detachment underground.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka nau'ukan gyada masu juriya, yi lafce da hatsi, kuma a cire gyada a kan kari kafin ta tsinke a kasa.

diseases.name: Groundnut Rust
diseases.causes: Fungus (Puccinia arachidis) spread by wind-blown spores during rainy spells.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari da iska ke dauka a lokacin damina mai yawan ruwan sama.
diseases.symptoms: Orange-brown to dark chestnut pustules on lower leaf surface, leaves curl, dry up and look scorched but remain attached.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ƙuraje masu launin tsatsa ja-kasa a kasan ganye, ganyen na bushewa kamar an kona shi amma baya zubewa da wuri.
diseases.treatment: Spray combination of tebuconazole or chlorothalonil at early appearance of orange pustules.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin tebuconazole ko chlorothalonil da zaran an ga kurajen tsatsa a kasan ganye.
diseases.prevention: Eradicate volunteer groundnut plants between seasons; plant resistant varieties like SAMNUT 24.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Tumɓuke gyadar da ta tsira da kanta bayan kaka; shuka irin SAMNUT 24 mai jure tsatsa.

diseases.name: Healthy Groundnut
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — gyada tana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau.
diseases.symptoms: Lush dark green 4-leaflet foliage forming complete ground cover, clean yellow flowers pegging smoothly into soft soil.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye kore mai kyau mai ganye hudu-hudu dake lullube kasa, fure mai rawaya, da kafuwar gyada a kasa lafiya lau.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep soil loose around plant base for peg penetration.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Tabbatar da kasa tana da laushi a gindin shuka don gyadar ta shiga kasa cikin sauki.
diseases.prevention: Apply single superphosphate (SSP) fertilizer for calcium/phosphorus pod filling, and weed before pegging stage.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Zuba takin SSP don samun sinadarin calcium da phosphorus wajen cikar gyada, kuma a yi ciyawa da wuri.

name: Rice
description: Primary grain grown under lowland, upland, and irrigation ecologies.
description_hausa: Shuka mai muhimmanci da ake nomawa a fadama da tudu.

diseases.name: Rice Blast
diseases.causes: Fungus (Magnaporthe oryzae) triggered by high humidity, overcast rainy days, and excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai yaduwa saboda laima, giza-gizan damina, da yawan takin nitrogen (urea).
diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped diamond lesions with gray or whitish centers and reddish-brown borders; rotting "neck blast" snapping panicles.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Raunuka masu siffar diamond da tsakiya mai launin toka da baki a gefe; ruɓewar wuyan zangarniyar shinkafa har ta karye.
diseases.treatment: Drain field briefly to aerate roots; apply tricyclazole or isoprothiolane before panicles fully emerge.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Zubar da ruwa na ɗan lokaci don saiwa ta samu iska; fesa maganin tricyclazole kafin zangarniya ta fito gaba daya.
diseases.prevention: Split nitrogen urea applications into 3 doses; avoid dense planting; plant resistant FARO varieties (e.g., FARO 44, FARO 52).
diseases.prevention_hausa: Raba zuba takin urea kashi uku; kaucewa shuka a matse; kuma a shuka nau'ukan FARO 44 ko FARO 52 masu juriya.

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB)
diseases.causes: Bacterium (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae) spread by irrigation water, storms, and pruning seedlings.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar bakteriya da ruwan ban ruwa, guguwar damina, da yanke karshen ganyen shuka ke yadawa.
diseases.symptoms: Wavy water-soaked margins starting at leaf tips turning yellow then bleached white; bacterial ooze drops in morning.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Karshen ganye na komawa fari da rawaya yana shigowa ciki da zane mai taguwar ruwa; ɗigon ruwan bakteriya da safe.
diseases.treatment: Drain floodwater and stop nitrogen fertilizer immediately; apply copper bactericide to slow progress.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Zubar da ruwa kuma a dakatar da takin urea nan take; fesa maganin tagulla (copper) don tsaida yaduwarsa.
diseases.prevention: Do not clip seedling leaves before transplanting; maintain balanced potassium fertilization; use resistant varieties.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kada a yanke bakin ganyen shinkafa yayin dashe; sa takin potassium; kuma a shuka iri mai juriya.

diseases.name: Rice Yellow Mottle Virus (RYMV)
diseases.causes: Sobemovirus endemic to Africa, spread mechanically and by leaf-feeding chrysomelid beetles in lowland paddies.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar cutar virus ta musamman a Afirka da kwarin ganye ke yadawa a fadamar shinkafa.
diseases.symptoms: Yellow or orange leaf discoloration, spiraling linear mottling, plant stunting, reduced tillering, poorly exerted empty panicles.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye na komawa launin rawaya ko lemu, zane a jikin ganye, shuka tana zama gajera, da zangarniya marar hatsi.
diseases.treatment: No chemical cure. Rogue out infected clumps immediately; burn stubble after harvest to eliminate virus reservoirs.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin feshi. Tumɓuke shukan da suka kamu; kona ragowar ciyawa bayan girbi don hana sake bullowar cutar.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant lowland varieties (such as FARO 57, NERICA-L series); avoid overlapping continuous rice crops.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka nau'ukan FARO 57 ko NERICA-L masu juriya; kuma a huta gona kafin sake shuka wata shinkafar.

diseases.name: Brown Spot
diseases.causes: Fungus (Bipolaris oryzae) attacking rice growing in nutrient-deficient, poor sandy, or drought-stressed soils.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake kama shinkafar da ke cikin talaucin taki, kasan yashi, ko rashin isasshen ruwa.
diseases.symptoms: Small oval, dark brown spots with gray or whitish centers across leaves; discolored chalky unviable grains.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kananan ɗigo masu launin ruwan kasa da tsakiya mai toka a ganye; hatsin shinkafar na zama marar kyau kuma yana baci.
diseases.treatment: Apply potassium and balanced NPK fertilizer to restore plant vigor; spray mancozeb if severe.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Zuba takin potassium da NPK don karfafa shukar; fesa maganin mancozeb idan tabon ya yi yawa.
diseases.prevention: Soil testing, applying organic manure, seed dressing with thiram/carbendazim before sowing.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Sanya takin gargajiya a gona, da wanke iri da maganin fungi kafin shukawa.

diseases.name: Healthy Rice
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous tillering and healthy green upright leaves.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — shinkafa tana cikin koshin lafiya da rassa masu yawa da ganye kore.
diseases.symptoms: Erect clean green leaf blades, profuse vigorous tillers, strong healthy root crowns, heavy drooping golden panicles.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Tsaye mike da ganye kore ba tare da wani tabo ba, rassa masu yawa, da zangarniya mai nauyi cike da hatsi mai launin zinare.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep water depth at 5–7 cm during reproductive stage.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Tabbatar da ruwan fadamar yana da zurfin sentimita 5 zuwa 7 yayin da take fitar da zangarniya.
diseases.prevention: Maintain weed-free paddies, scout for stem borers, and drain field 10 days before harvesting.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kiyaye tsaftar fadama, duba kwari, kuma a zubar da ruwan kwanaki 10 kafin girbi.

name: Soybeans
description: High-protein grain legume and lucrative cash crop grown across Northern Nigeria for food, oil processing, and soil nitrogen enrichment.
description_hausa: Muhimmin amfanin gona mai gina jiki da ake nomawa a Arewacin Najeriya domin mai, abinci, da kuma sanya takin azot a ƙasa.

diseases.name: Soybean Mosaic Virus (SMV)
diseases.causes: Potyvirus transmitted by soybean aphids and through infected planting seed.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar virus da kwarin aphid ke yadawa da kuma irin shuka da ke dauke da cutar.
diseases.symptoms: Crinkled rugose leaves, dark green blister-like patches along veins, stunted plants, mottled discolored seeds.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye mai lanƙwasa da kunkuma, ɗigo-ɗigo masu duhu a jikin jijiyoyin ganye, da hatsin waken soya mai baki-baki.
diseases.treatment: No chemical remedy. Rogue out infected plants; save seeds only from completely disease-free fields.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin feshi. Tumɓuke shukar da ta kamu; adana irin shuka kawai daga gonar da bata kamu ba.
diseases.prevention: Plant certified virus-free seeds (TGx series); control early aphid populations with botanical sprays.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka ingantaccen irin TGx mara cuta; kuma a kashe kwarin aphid a farkon shuka.

diseases.name: Bacterial Pustule
diseases.causes: Bacterium (Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. glycines) spread by splashing rain and farm equipment.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar bakteriya mai wanzuwa a sauran shuka da iri, mai yaduwa ta yayyafin ruwan sama.
diseases.symptoms: Small, pale yellow-green spots with elevated pustule centers on lower surface; lesions tear, giving ragged leaf appearance.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ɗigo masu launin rawaya-kore da ƙuraje a kasan ganye; ganyen na yagewa yana zama kamar an yayyaga shi.
diseases.treatment: Spray copper hydroxide bactericide early; bury crop residues deeply after harvest; avoid moving through wet fields.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin tagulla da wuri; binne ragowar shuka bayan girbi; kada a shiga gona idan ganye na da laima.
diseases.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds; rotate with maize or sorghum for at least 2 seasons.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi amfani da ingantaccen iri mara cuta; canza shuka da masara ko dawa na tsawon kaka biyu.

diseases.name: Soybean Rust (Asian Rust)
diseases.causes: Airborne fungus (Phakopsora pachyrhizi) favored by warm, humid rainy seasons with prolonged leaf wetness.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai yaduwa ta iska a lokacin damina mai dumi da raɓa da ke daɗewa a kan ganye.
diseases.symptoms: Small reddish-brown to tan pustules on underside of leaves; leaves turn yellow and drop prematurely, causing stunted pods.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ƙananan ɗigo masu launin ruwan kasa a kasan ganye; ganye na komawa rawaya yana zubewa, yana rage cikar kwasfa.
diseases.treatment: Apply systemic fungicide (e.g., azoxystrobin + difenoconazole or Mancozeb) at first flowering or first sign of pustules.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin naman gwari (azoxystrobin ko Mancozeb) tun a lokacin fara fure ko da zaran an ga ɗigo.
diseases.prevention: Plant certified rust-resistant TGx varieties; avoid excessively dense planting to improve airflow; practice crop rotation.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka ingantaccen irin TGx mai jure tsatsa; bada isasshen fili don samun iska; canza shuka da hatsi.

diseases.name: Pod Blight
diseases.causes: Fungus (Diaporthe phaseolorum / Phomopsis) favored by warm, humid weather at pod maturity.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake barna a lokacin da kwasfar waken soya ke nuna a cikin laima.
diseases.symptoms: Numerous black specks arranged in lines on dry pods, premature pod drying, shriveled moldy cracked seeds inside.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Digo-digo baƙaƙe a jere a jikin kwasfa, kwasfar na bushewa da wuri, da kwayar waken soya marar cika mai fari.
diseases.treatment: Apply thiophanate-methyl or azoxystrobin at early pod fill stage if rainy weather persists.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin thiophanate-methyl a lokacin da kwasfa ta fara kankama idan ana ruwan sama.
diseases.prevention: Harvest promptly as soon as pods turn brown; do not leave dry pods standing in wet fields; plant high-quality seeds.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kwashe girbi da sauri da zaran kwasfa ta bushe; kada a bar ta a gona idan damina na ci gaba.

diseases.name: Healthy Soybeans
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — waken soya yana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau.
diseases.symptoms: Deep green trifoliate leaves, sturdy hairy stems, healthy pink internal root nodules, densely clustered pods.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye kore mai kyau, kara mai karfi da gashi-gashi, saiwa mai kumburin takin azot mai ruwan hoda a ciki, da kwasfofi masu cika.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Scout for pod borers and stinkbugs during pod fill.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Kula da binciken kwarin kwasfa a lokacin da waken soya ke nuna.
diseases.prevention: Inoculate seed with Rhizobium for nitrogen fixation, maintain weed control, and harvest on time.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Sanya maganin kwayoyin bakteriyar rhizobium a iri domin kafa taki a kasa, kuma a yi girbi a kan kari.

name: Yam
description: Cultural and nutritional king tuber cultivated heavily in Benue, Niger, and Taraba.
description_hausa: Sarkin abinci a jihar Binuwai, Neja, da Taraba.

diseases.name: Yam Mosaic Virus (YMV)
diseases.causes: Potyvirus transmitted by cotton aphids (Aphis gossypii) and through infected seed tubers.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayar virus da kwarin aphid ke yadawa da kuma irin doyar da ke dauke da cutar.
diseases.symptoms: Light green and dark green leaf mosaic patterns, shoestringing of leaf blades, stunted vine growth, reduced tuber size.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Zane mai kore da rawaya a ganyen doya, ganye na zama siriri kamar zaren takalmi, da rashin girman doya a kasa.
diseases.treatment: No cure once infected. Rogue out severely diseased plants; do not use tubers from infected vines as seed setts.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin warkarwa. Tumɓuke shukar da ta kamu; kada a yi amfani da doyar mai ciwo a matsayin irin shuka.
diseases.prevention: Use certified virus-indexed micro-setts; control aphid populations with botanical neem sprays; weed field margins.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka irin doya mai inganci daga cibiyar bincike, fesa maganin dogon yaro don kashe aphid, da cire ciyawa.

diseases.name: Yam Anthracnose (Dieback)
diseases.causes: Fungus (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides) exacerbated by heavy rains, warm humidity, and un-staked vines.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai son ruwan sama, laima, da igiyar doyar da ba a daura a kan sanda ba.
diseases.symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with yellow borders coalescing into severe scorching, blackening, and vine dieback.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Digo-digo baƙaƙe a ganye da jikin igiyar doya, yana konewa yana komawa baki har igiyar ta bushe daga sama.
diseases.treatment: Spray with Mancozeb or azoxystrobin upon first appearance of spots; stake vines high off muddy ridges.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa Mancozeb ko azoxystrobin da zaran an ga alamar tabo; ɗaura igiyar doya a kan sanduna masu tsawo.
diseases.prevention: Treat seed yams with wood ash and fungicide dip before planting; practice 3-year crop rotation.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Wanke irin doya da toka da maganin fungi kafin shukawa; canza gona na tsawon shekaru 3.

diseases.name: Yam Tuber Rot
affected_parts: Tuber flesh in soil and storage
diseases.causes: Fungi (Botryodiplodia theobromae, Fusarium oxysporum, Penicillium) invading through harvest wounds and nematode bites.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari da ke shiga ta raunin fartanya yayin kwashe doya ko cizon tsutsar kasa.
diseases.symptoms: Soft, water-soaked brown internal rot smelling sour, tuber skin collapsing, black/blue fungal mold inside flesh.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ruɓewa mai laushi da wari a cikin doya, fatar doyar na lotsewa, da gari mai launin baki ko shudi a cikin doyar.
diseases.treatment: Cut away slightly rotted portions and coat clean wound with dry wood ash; store tubers in cool airy ventilated racks.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Yanke wurin da ya rube a shafa tokar itace a wurin; ajiye doya a kan gadon katako mai iska a rumbu.
diseases.prevention: Harvest with extreme care to avoid wounding tubers; cure tubers for 4 days in warm shade; never store bruised tubers.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi girbi a hankali don kada fartanya ta ji wa doya ciwo; shanya doyar a inuwa kafin ajiya.

diseases.name: Yam Nematode (Dry Rot)
diseases.causes: Microscopic root-knot and yam nematodes (Scutellonema bradys) feeding inside the outer layers of the tuber.
diseases.causes_hausa: Ƙananan tsutsotsin ƙasa (nematodes) dake cin fatar doya da karkashin fatarta a cikin kasa.
diseases.symptoms: Cracked, scaly flaking tuber skin, shallow brown-black dry rot beneath the skin, unmarketable diseased tubers.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Fatar doya na tsattsagewa tana barewa kamar kankara, busasshen ruɓa baki a karkashin fata.
diseases.treatment: Dip seed tubers in hot water at 50°C for 30 minutes before planting to kill internal nematodes without harming buds.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Tsoma irin doya a ruwan dumi (50°C) na minti 30 kafin shukawa don kashe tsutsar da ke ciki.
diseases.prevention: Apply neem cake or organic compost to planting mounds; rotate with marigold or non-host legumes.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Sanya tokar dogon yaro ko takin gargajiya a cikin tulin doya; canza shuka da amfanin gonar da basa cin nematode.

diseases.name: Healthy Yam
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy dark green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — doya tana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau.
diseases.symptoms: Vigorous twining green vines, broad heart-shaped leaves without blemishes, smooth heavy uninjured tubers.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Igiyar doya mai kauri da ganye kore mai siffar zuciya ba tare da tabo ba, da doya mai kauri da santsi a kasa.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep mounds mulched and weed-free.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Lullube tulin doya da ciyawa don rike laima da kiyaye ciyawa.
diseases.prevention: Ensure tall staking for sunlight interception and inspect vines after heavy rain.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Tabbatar da daura igiyar doya a kan dogon sanda domin samun hasken rana da duba ta bayan ruwan sama.

name: Wheat
description: Irrigated cool-season winter cereal cultivated across Kano, Jigawa, and Borno basin.
description_hausa: Hatsi na lokacin sanyi da ake nomawa a fadama a Kano, Jigawa, da Borno.

diseases.name: Wheat Rust (Stem, Stripe & Leaf Rust)
diseases.causes: Fungi (Puccinia graminis / Puccinia triticina) spread by windborne spores in mild, damp weather.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake yawo a iska a lokacin sanyi da laima a fadamar alkama.
diseases.symptoms: Reddish-orange to chestnut-brown elongated pustules breaking through epidermal layers of stems and leaves.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ƙuraje masu launin ja-kasa ko tsatsa da ke ɓallewa a jikin karan alkama da ganyenta suna fitar da gari.
diseases.treatment: Apply systemic fungicide (e.g., tebuconazole or propiconazole) as soon as first pustules appear.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin tebuconazole ko propiconazole da zaran an ga alamar tsatsa a jikin ganye.
diseases.prevention: Plant certified wheat varieties resistant to current rust strains (e.g., Reyna-28, Norman); avoid delayed sowing.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka ingantaccen irin alkama mai jure cutar tsatsa, kuma a shuka a kan kari a watan Nuwamba.

diseases.name: Wheat Blast
diseases.causes: Fungus (Magnaporthe oryzae Triticum pathotype) attacking heads during warm, humid reproductive periods.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai kai hari a kan zangarniyar alkama a lokacin zafi da laima.
diseases.symptoms: Bleaching of upper spike heads while lower stem remains green, blackening of the rachis node, completely sterile empty heads.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Karshen zangarniyar alkama na komawa fari yayin da kasan ke da kore, zangarniyar na bushewa ba tare da kwaya ba.
diseases.treatment: Spray strobilurin + triazole combination fungicide at heading/flowering stage if conditions favor blast.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin fungi a lokacin da alkama ke fitar da zangarniya idan yanayi ya nuna zafi da laima.
diseases.prevention: Use certified clean seed treated with fungicide, plant early in cool window (Nov 15 - Dec 10 in Northern Nigeria).
diseases.prevention_hausa: Yi wa iri magani kafin shuka, kuma a shuka da wuri a lokacin sanyin Nuwamba zuwa farkon Disamba.

diseases.name: Septoria Leaf Blotch
diseases.causes: Fungus (Zymoseptoria tritici) splash-dispersed by irrigation water and winter rains.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake yaduwa ta hanyar ruwan ban ruwa da raɓar sanyi.
diseases.symptoms: Irregular yellowish-brown necrotic blotches speckled with tiny black pimple-like fruiting bodies (pycnidia).
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Raunuka masu launin ruwan kasa da ɗigo-ɗigo baƙaƙe kamar kwayoyin fari a jikin ganyen alkama.
diseases.treatment: Foliar application of epoxiconazole or prothioconazole when flag leaf emerges.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin epoxiconazole a lokacin da ganyen karshe na sama ya fito.
diseases.prevention: Bury crop residue after harvest; rotate with non-cereal crops; select tolerant varieties.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Binne ragowar shuka bayan girbi; canza gona da shukar da ba hatsi ba; kuma a zabi iri mai juriya.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.causes: Fungus (Blumeria graminis f. sp. tritici) thriving in dense, highly fertilized wheat under dry-humid air.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake yaduwa a gonar alkamar da aka sa mata takin urea da yawa kuma aka shuka ta a matse.
diseases.symptoms: White powdery fluffy patches on upper leaf surfaces turning gray-brown with tiny black dots; leaves yellow and dry.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Farin gari kamar toka a saman ganye yana komawa launin toka, yana sa ganye zama rawaya da bushewa.
diseases.treatment: Spray with sulfur or tebuconazole if mildew climbs up to the top two leaves before grain filling.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin sulfur ko tebuconazole idan garin ya haura zuwa ganyen sama kafin cikar alkama.
diseases.prevention: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization; optimize seeding density for airflow; plant resistant seed.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Kada a cika takin nitrogen fiye da kima; kada a shuka a matse domin samun iska; kuma a shuka iri mai juriya.

diseases.name: Healthy Wheat
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous tillering and healthy green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — alkama tana cikin koshin lafiya da rassa masu kyau da ganye kore.
diseases.symptoms: Dense lush green tillers, clean erect flag leaves, compact heads with long awns and plumping grain.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Rassa masu yawa da ganye kore ba tare da wani tabo ko fari ba, zangarniya mai tsawo cike da hatsi mai lafiya.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain 7-10 day furrow irrigation intervals during grain filling.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Ci gaba da ba da ruwa kowanne kwanaki 7 zuwa 10 har sai hatsi ya cika.
diseases.prevention: Stop watering when grain reaches hard dough stage to enable uniform field drying.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Dakatar da ban ruwa a lokacin da hatsin ya yi tauri don ba shi damar bushewa sosai a gona.

name: Sorghum
description: Drought-tolerant staple grain central to Northern Nigerian food security.
description_hausa: Abincin gargajiya mai jure fari da ake amfani da shi sosai a Arewa.

diseases.name: Sorghum Ergot (Sugary Disease)
diseases.causes: Fungus (Claviceps africana) infecting unfertilized flowers during cool, cloudy, humid mornings.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake kama furen dawa kafin ya kankama kwaya a lokacin sanyi da laima.
diseases.symptoms: Sticky, sweet pinkish-orange droplets ("honeydew") oozing from florets, turning into white crusts and hard black sclerotia.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Zubar da ruwa mai zaki kamar zuma mai launin ruwan hoda daga kan dawa, dake komawa fari da baƙaƙen kwayoyi.
diseases.treatment: No direct in-field chemical cure. Harvest cleanly and do not feed ergot-contaminated grain to livestock.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin feshi a gona. Kada a ciyar da dabbar gida dawon da ke da cutar ergot saboda guba ce.
diseases.prevention: Plant high-pollen producing varieties with uniform flowering; avoid late season sowing into cool periods.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka nau'in dawar dake fitar da zaren fure da yawa a lokaci guda, kuma a guji shuka a makare.

diseases.name: Sorghum Smut (Covered & Loose Smut)
diseases.causes: Fungi (Sporisorium sorghi / S. cruentum) carried on seeds and infecting seedlings at germination.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake jikin irin shuka yana kama dawar tun lokacin da ta fito a kasa.
diseases.symptoms: Grains replaced by oval grayish-white smut sacs filled with black powdery spores; loose smut turns whole head black.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kwayoyin dawa na komawa buhunan gari fari-fari masu cike da bakin gari; daukacin kan dawar yana zama baki.
diseases.treatment: Carefully bag and remove smutted heads before sacs break and disperse spores across the farm.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Rufe kan dawar da buhu a yanke shi a hankali a kona shi kafin bakin garin ya bazu a gona.
diseases.prevention: Seed dressing with thiram, mancozeb or apron star before planting; plant certified disease-free seed.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Wanke irin dawa da maganin Apron Star ko thiram kafin shukawa; shuka ingantaccen iri mara cuta.

diseases.name: Anthracnose
diseases.causes: Fungus (Colletotrichum sublineolum) favored by high humidity, warm rain splashes, and dense canopy.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari mai yaduwa ta hanyar ruwan sama, laima, da kuma yawan cushewar shuka.
diseases.symptoms: Circular to elliptical spots with red, purple or brown borders with black fungal spots inside, stalk rot causing lodging.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ɗigo-ɗigo masu kewayen ja, ruwan hoda da baki a jikin ganye da karan dawa, yana sa dawar kwanciya a kasa.
diseases.treatment: Apply foliar fungicide (Mancozeb or carbendazim) if severe on flag leaf before flowering.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin Mancozeb idan cutar ta haura zuwa ganyen sama kafin dawa ta yi zangarniya.
diseases.prevention: Rotate with cowpea, groundnut, or soybean; plow under dry crop residues; avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Canza shuka da wake, gyada, ko waken soya; binne ragowar shuka; kuma a guji yawan takin nitrogen.

diseases.name: Sorghum Midge
diseases.causes: Tiny orange-red flies (Stenodiplosis sorghicola) laying eggs inside flowering spikelets where larvae eat young seeds.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kananan kuda masu launin lemu da ke yin kwai a cikin furen dawa, tsutsa ta cinye kwayar dawar.
diseases.symptoms: Panicles look normal from afar but grain heads are flat and empty ("chaffy heads"), pupal cases poke out of glumes.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kan dawar yana zama marar nauyi babu komai a ciki (zangarniyar zama), kwasfar furen na zama babu hatsi.
diseases.treatment: Spray pyrethroid insecticides (e.g., cypermethrin) during early morning when 25-50% of the field is in flower.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin cypermethrin da sassafe lokacin da kashi 25 zuwa 50% na dawar ke fitar da fure.
diseases.prevention: Synchronize planting dates in the community so all sorghum flowers at once; burn old chaff and wild grass hosts.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka a lokaci guda tare da makwabta don dawar ta yi fure a lokaci daya; share ciyawar daji a bakin gona.

diseases.name: Healthy Sorghum
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous growth and healthy green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — dawa tana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau da zangarniya mai cika.
diseases.symptoms: Thick strong stalk, broad arched green leaves with white midrib, large dense panicle filled with plump clean grains.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Karan dawa mai kauri da karfi, faffadan ganye kore, da katafariyar zangarniya cike da hatsi mai koshin lafiya.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Protect ripening panicles from birds.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Tsare zangarniyar da ke nuna daga tsuntsaye.
diseases.prevention: Apply balanced NPK and urea top-dressing, control striga witchweed early, and harvest on time.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Sa daidaitaccen taki, cire ciyawar kuduji (wuta-wuta) da wuri, kuma a yi girbi da zaran hatsi ya bushe.

name: Pearl Millet
description: Fast-maturing, resilient crop grown across the semi-arid northern belts.
description_hausa: Shuka mai saurin nuna da ke jure fari a yankin arewa mai zafi.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew (Green Ear)
diseases.causes: Oomycete pathogen (Sclerospora graminicola) surviving in soil as oospores and carried on seed.
diseases.causes_hausa: Kwayoyin cuta dake zama a cikin ƙasa ko jikin iri a yankin arewa.
diseases.symptoms: Chlorotic yellow leaf streaks with white downy growth underneath; floral ear head turns into a leafy broom ("green ear").
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ganye na zama rawaya da fari a ƙasa; kan geron yana zama ganye kamar tsintsiya maimakon hatsi.
diseases.treatment: Rogue out infected green-ear plants immediately and bury them before airborne sporangia spread.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Tumɓuke shukar da ta nuna wannan alama da sauri a ƙone ko a binne ta.
diseases.prevention: Seed dressing with metalaxyl (Apron Star); plant certified resistant varieties like SOSAT-C88 or LCIC-MV1.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Wanke iri da Apron Star (metalaxyl); shuka nau'in SOSAT-C88 ko LCIC-MV1 mai juriya.

diseases.name: Ergot
diseases.causes: Fungus (Claviceps fusiformis) infecting during protogyny flowering in humid rainy periods.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari dake kama furen gero a lokacin da ruwan sama da laima suka hadu da fure.
diseases.symptoms: Pinkish-amber sweet fluid dripping from florets, turning into hard dark brown or black curved sclerotia in the head.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ruwa mai zaki ruwan hoda dake zuba daga kan gero, dake bushewa yana komawa baƙaƙen kwayoyi masu tauri.
diseases.treatment: No field cure. Float seed in 10% saltwater to remove floating ergot sclerotia before planting.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu maganin feshi a gona. Zuba irin a ruwan gishiri don cire ergot da ke taso sama kafin shuka.
diseases.prevention: Synchronize community sowing dates to ensure rapid cross-pollination; avoid late-planted plots.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka a lokaci guda da makwabta domin fure ya kankama da sauri; guji makarar shuka.

diseases.name: Millet Rust
diseases.causes: Fungus (Puccinia substriata var. indica) airborne during humid late-season periods.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari da iska ke yadawa a karshen damina a lokacin laima.
diseases.symptoms: Small, reddish-brown powdery pustules forming lines on both leaf surfaces, leaves dry up and die prematurely.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Ƙuraje masu launin ja-kasa da ke fitar da gari a jikin ganye, ganyen na bushewa kafin hatsi ya cika.
diseases.treatment: Foliar spray with mancozeb or propiconazole if rust appears before flowering.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Fesa maganin mancozeb ko propiconazole idan tsatsar ta bayyana kafin gero ya fitar da kan hatsi.
diseases.prevention: Plant resistant early-maturing cultivars; avoid delayed plantings near riverbeds.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Shuka nau'ukan gero masu saurin nuna; kuma a guji jinkirta shuka a fadama.

diseases.name: Smut
diseases.causes: Fungus (Moesziomyces bullatus) airborne spores landing on young florets.
diseases.causes_hausa: Naman gwari da iska ke hurawa a kan furen gero a lokacin da yake fitowa.
diseases.symptoms: Scattered oval green galls that swell larger than normal grains, turning dark brown to black and bursting powdery spores.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kwayoyin gero na zama manyan kuraje kore dake kumbura su koma baki su fashe da bakin gari.
diseases.treatment: Collect and bury smutted heads before galls rupture; solarize grain thoroughly.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Yanke kan geron da ya kamu a binne kafin ya fashe; a shanya hatsi a rana sosai.
diseases.prevention: Seed treatment with thiram/metalaxyl; crop rotation and destroying volunteer millet stools.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Wanke iri da maganin Apron Star ko thiram; canza shuka da cire tsohuwar shuka.

diseases.name: Healthy Pearl Millet
diseases.causes: None — crop exhibits vigorous drought-tolerant growth and healthy green foliage.
diseases.causes_hausa: Babu cuta — gero yana cikin koshin lafiya da ganye masu kyau da zangarniya mai cika.
diseases.symptoms: Sturdy upright tillers, smooth green leaves with rough edges, long compact cylindrical candle heads densely packed with grain.
diseases.symptoms_hausa: Kara mai karfi, ganye kore mai tsabta ba tare da tabo ba, da dogon kan gero kamar kyandir cike da hatsi lafiya lau.
diseases.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep plots weeded and protect heads from grain-eating birds.
diseases.treatment_hausa: Babu bukatar magani. Yi huda a kan kari kuma a tsare zangarniya daga tsuntsaye.
diseases.prevention: Thin seedlings to 2-3 plants per stand, apply compost or micro-dose fertilizer, and harvest when heads brown.
diseases.prevention_hausa: Rage cunkoson shuka zuwa 2-3 a rami daya, sa takin gargajiya, kuma a girbe da zaran kan ya bushe.
